newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean minister urges oil firms to cut imports.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean minister urges oil firms to cut imports.

text.p: South Korea's Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Ahn Kwang-koo on Wednesday urged five local oil companies to reduce oil imports to help narrow the widening trade deficit.

"Oil imports, which have increased steadily following the rise of international oil prices and growing local demand, have been putting pressure on (the) growing trade deficit," Ahn told heads of five oil firms in a luncheon meeting.
He asked the company heads to help improve the nation's trade deficit by "cutting back on imports of unessential oil".
But the ministry would not force the firms to reduce imports, the ministry officials said.
Ahn also asked the oil companies to cooperate with the government-led campaign to conserve energy.
He said the firms should improve their competitiveness to prepare themselves for opening the local oil market to foreign suppliers in 1999.
